## 3. The two second-of-minute heuristics, with and without (`Config(use_timing_heuristics=False)`, CLI `--no-timing-heuristics`)

| variant / split | cases | status | step P | step R | step F1 | resource-discovery F1 | exact rows | mean LCS |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| heuristics ON (default) / dev | 23 | 23/23 | 100.0% | 97.8% | **98.9%** | 98.0% | 20/23 | 98.1% |
| heuristics ON (default) / not tuned against in Phase 2-3 | 9 | 9/9 | 100.0% | 100.0% | **100.0%** | 100.0% | 9/9 | 100.0% |
| heuristics ON (default) / all | 32 | 32/32 | 100.0% | 98.4% | **99.2%** | 98.6% | 29/32 | 98.6% |
| heuristics OFF / dev | 23 | 23/23 | 100.0% | 95.6% | **97.7%** | 95.9% | 17/23 | 97.3% |
| heuristics OFF / not tuned against in Phase 2-3 | 9 | 9/9 | 100.0% | 96.6% | **98.2%** | 97.0% | 7/9 | 95.6% |
| heuristics OFF / all | 32 | 32/32 | 100.0% | 95.9% | **97.9%** | 96.3% | 24/32 | 96.8% |

| main set | rows without an account step (real misses) | accounts: explicit / eliminated / timing / ambiguous / none | anonymized analytics: chain / timing / elimination / ambiguous |
|---|---|---|---|
| heuristics ON (default) | 27 | 239 / 189 / 44 / 25 / 11 | 33 / 68 / 0 / 28 |
| heuristics OFF | 110 | 239 / 150 / 0 / 108 / 11 | 33 / 0 / 17 / 145 |

Hold-out (cases whose resource is linked explicitly are hidden, the real code runs; `stolen` = the hidden case's resource went to another case):

| setting | hidden cases | correct | wrong | stolen | omitted | precision of assignments |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| accounts, 30% hidden x 30 seeds, heuristics ON | 2250 | 2217 (98.5%) | 0 | 0 | 33 | **100.0%** |
| accounts, 30% hidden x 30 seeds, heuristics OFF | 2250 | 1643 (73.0%) | 0 | 0 | 607 | **100.0%** |
| accounts, 50% hidden x 30 seeds, heuristics ON | 3780 | 3682 (97.4%) | 0 | 0 | 98 | **100.0%** |
| accounts, 50% hidden x 30 seeds, heuristics OFF | 3780 | 2500 (66.1%) | 0 | 0 | 1280 | **100.0%** |
| anonymized analytics, 30% of chain pairs hidden x 30 seeds, heuristic ON | 300 | 300 (100.0%) | 0 | 0 | 0 | **100.0%** |
| anonymized analytics, same, heuristic OFF | 300 | 221 (73.7%) | 0 | 0 | 79 | **100.0%** |

**Read this before trusting those numbers.** Both heuristics exploit a regularity of *this dataset's synthetic event timing*: inside one case the worker's events keep a fixed second-of-minute offset from the account-delete event (learned from the explicitly linked cases), and the anonymization event sits 40/41 s after it. Real production logs are produced by independent services with unsynchronised clocks, retries and jitter, so such offsets would not exist and the heuristic would neither help nor be safe to rely on. They are kept because they raise the score on this challenge's data, they are measured by hold-out, and they are switchable with one flag. The older timeline rules (account delete 45-75 min before `reported_at`, analytics ~29 min before, 390/449 s gaps between policy actions) are timing regularities of the same kind and are switched off by `--no-discovery` (which also drops the account/analytics steps they find), not by this flag.
